info.title: MICROSERVICE-testDev-Create Catalog Olivine Recliner Detail-v1-spec
info.description: The Olivine Recliner Detail Creation API enables businesses to efficiently create and manage detailed information for the Olivine Recliner product. This API facilitates the addition of specifications, pricing, and availability directly through the catalog system. Designed for inventory managers and product teams, it ensures that product details are always up-to-date and accessible for end-users. Integrating this API into e-commerce platforms enhances the consumer experience by providing accurate product information at their fingertips.

post.description: This endpoint allows you to create new details for the Olivine Recliner, including specifications and features that enhance user experience.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to submit details for the Olivine Recliner. It expects a JSON object that contains the necessary data to create or update the recliner's details.
